visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: small centred circular org icon/logo above the title
visualCharacteristics.structure: centred card: icon, bold title, centred description, outlined CTA button pinned to the card bottom
visualCharacteristics.columns: 3 on desktop, auto-fit on tablet, 1 on mobile; 2 stacked frames when placed in a narrow column

contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 icon/logo image (optional), cell 2 title (heading or bold paragraph), description paragraph(s), and a link-only CTA paragraph ('Learn more', 'Read Privacy Policy'). Used for OAIC/IDCARE/Scamwatch support cards on privacy.html and the policy-document frames on privacy/policy-documents.html.
